articles.title: Why India’s industrial sector is looking beyond the grid for energy security
articles.summary: India's industrial energy transition is not about abandoning the grid — it is about building greater control around it. articles.summary: In an innovative move, Sebi has rolled out Demat 2.0, a pilot scheme aimed at tokenising corporate bonds. This initiative facilitates rapid settlement and instant fund retrieval for investors. Future developments will broaden this system's reach to secondary markets and individual investors.

articles.summary: In 2022, Winzo Games Pvt Ltd filed a complaint against Google alleging restrictions for Real Money Games (RMG) on Google Play and about advertisement policy, among others. articles.summary: The European Commission has asked EU member states for approval to sign and conclude its landmark Free Trade Agreement with India, a deal that would eliminate or reduce tariffs on 96% of EU goods exports and save exporters an estimated €4 billion a year. articles.title: Sebi proposes new CAS framework, two options for expiry-day settlement
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is set to implement crucial updates to the Closing Auction Session. A focus of these changes is on the process of derivatives settlement on expiry days. SEBI has laid out two alternatives for determining the derivatives settlement price: the first proposes a blended VWAP approach after one year, while the second keeps the current CTS VWAP process in place for the present.

articles.title: 10-year bond yield crosses 7% as RBI trims auction bids
articles.summary: On Friday, benchmark government bond yields climbed by five basis points, surpassing the 7% threshold. The Reserve Bank of India managed to accept less than half of the amount it had targeted in a three-year bond auction. Factors such as high global risk-free rates and escalating crude oil prices are exerting pressure on Indian bonds.
